title: Cities of refuge
english: [[Appoint cities of refuge for the one who kills without intent >> Bible:Joshua 20:1-6]]. Christ is the soul’s refuge; the road runs until the high priest’s death — until Christ’s passion.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: Three west and three east
english: Three west of Jordan, three east — refuge everywhere. The church opens asylums in every land.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: Avenger and due process
english: He must not be handed to the blood-avenger before judgment. Justice joined to mercy. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).
